tour.description:
Die **Deutschen Ländermeisterschaften 2026** finden vom 7. bis 12. Oktober in Duderstadt statt. Gespielt werden sieben Runden im Schweizer System. Die Bedenkzeit beträgt 90 Minuten für 40 Züge, 30 Minuten für den Rest der Partie und 30 Sekunden Inkrement pro Zug. Jede Landesschachjugend darf ein Team melden. Die acht Bretter müssen mit folgenden Altersklassen besetzt werden: U20, U20w, U18, U16, U16w, U14, U12, U12w. 

Alle Infos, Aufstellungen, Ergebnisse, Tabellen etc. gibt es auf der [DSJ-Website](https://www.deutsche-schachjugend.de/2026/dlm/)


The German Youth State Team Championship takes place from October 7th until October 12th 2026 in Duderstadt, Germany. It is a 7-round Swiss tournament featuring teams of 8 youths of each of the age groups u20, g20, u18, u16, g16, u14, u12 and g12. Players receive 90 minutes for the first 40 moves followed by 30 minutes for the rest of the game, plus 30-second increment per move starting from move one.

You can find further information and all results on our [Website](https://www.deutsche-schachjugend.de/2026/dlm/)

tour.name: 2026 Spanish Rapid Team Chess Championship
tour.description:
El Campeonato de España de Ajedrez Rápido por Equipos de Club 2026 se disputará los días 11 y 12 de octubre en los salones del Centro Ágora de Albacete, situado en la calle Lepanto, 55.

Organizado por la Federación Española de Ajedrez, con la colaboración de la Federación de Ajedrez de Castilla-La Mancha, el torneo se jugará a ocho rondas, con equipos de cuatro tableros y un ritmo de 10 minutos más 5 segundos de incremento por jugada.

Sigue aquí las partidas en directo, desde las 16:15 h del domingo 11 y las 10:00 h del lunes 12.

***

2026 Spanish Rapid Chess Championship for Club Teams will be held on October 11th and 12th at the Ágora Center in Albacete, located at 55 Lepanto Street. Organized by the Spanish Chess Federation, in collaboration with the Castilla-La Mancha Chess Federation, the tournament will consist of eight rounds, with teams of four boards and a time control of 10 minutes with a 5-second increment per move.

Follow the games live here, starting at 4:15 PM on Sunday 11th and 10:00 AM on Monday 12th.

tour.description:
**Dansk**

**Odensemesterskabet 2026**

Velkommen til livesendingen fra Odensemesterskabet 2026, som spilles den 9.–11. oktober 2026 på Giersings Realskole i Odense.

Turneringen arrangeres af Frem Skakklub og spilles som alle-mod-alle i 6-mandsgrupper, inddelt efter rating. Øverste gruppe spiller om titlen som Odensemester 2026.

Betænkningstiden er 90 minutter til 40 træk, derefter 30 minutter til resten af partiet samt 30 sekunders tillæg pr. træk fra træk 1. Turneringen rates både dansk og internationalt i de kvalificerede grupper.

Følg 12 partier pr. runde live her på Lichess gennem hele weekenden.

**English**

**Odense Championship 2026**

Welcome to the live broadcast of the Odense Championship 2026, taking place from 9–11 October 2026 at Giersings Realskole in Odense, Denmark.

The tournament is organised by Frem Skakklub and is played in six-player round-robin groups based on rating. The winner of the top group will earn the title of Odense Champion 2026.

The time control is 90 minutes for the first 40 moves, followed by 30 minutes for the rest of the game, with a 30-second increment from move 1. Eligible groups are rated both nationally in Denmark and by FIDE.

Follow 12 games per round live here on Lichess throughout the weekend.

Benidorm Chess Open 2026 | Group B
tour.description:
**Benidorm Chess Open** will take place from October 25th to November 1st in the elegant halls of the Meliá Hotel in Benidorm (Alicante), becoming the epicenter of international chess for nine intense days. The tournament will be played by the Swiss System over nine rounds, bringing together players of all levels in a unique setting.

With more than €25,000 in prize money, the event offers two spacious, carpeted playing rooms that guarantee comfort and concentration. It will also feature an interactive Fan Zone, where participants can analyze their games alongside a Grandmaster, enjoy free coffee and snacks, and participate in side activities designed to experience chess beyond the board.

[Official Website](https://benidormchess.com/?lang=en) | [Info64](https://info64.org/benidorm-chess-open-b-sub-2000-2026-1)

***

El **Benidorm Chess Open** se celebrará del 25 de octubre al 1 de noviembre en los elegantes salones del Hotel Meliá de Benidorm (Alicante), convirtiéndose en el epicentro del ajedrez internacional durante nueve intensas jornadas. El torneo se disputará bajo el Sistema Suizo a 9 rondas, reuniendo a jugadores de todos los niveles en un entorno único.

Con más de 25.000 € en premios en metálico, el evento ofrece dos amplias y enmoquetadas salas de juego que garantizan comodidad y concentración. Además, contará con una Fanzone interactiva, donde los participantes podrán analizar sus partidas junto a un Gran Maestro, disfrutar de café y snacks gratuitos, y participar en actividades paralelas diseñadas para vivir el ajedrez más allá del tablero.

[Web Oficial](https://benidormchess.com/) | [Info64](https://info64.org/benidorm-chess-open-b-sub-2000-2026-1)
